resources.string: In LSPosed, enable this module for System UI and System Framework, then reboot. System Framework is what blocks the power menu.
NoLockQS blocks the Quick Settings panel and the power menu while your device is locked, so connectivity toggles and power controls can\'t be used without unlocking.
Works on rooted Google Pixel phones running Android 15 or newer, with a libxposed API 101+ framework such as Vector.
This app does not collect any data and runs locally on your device.
